subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N57 across all 7 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N57 appears across seven model lines — 3, 4, 5 and 6 Series, plus X4, X5 and X6 — spanning the 2010-2019 production window.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with swirl flaps and EGR components inspected as part of the process.
